title: Match countries to capitals: Oceania
intro: Match each capital city with its country in Oceania.

pairs.explain: Canberra is the capital of Australia.
Suva is the capital of Fiji.
Palikir is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of).
Majuro is the capital of Marshall Islands.
Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea.
Melekeok is the capital of Palau.
Port Vila is the capital of Vanuatu.
Apia is the capital of Samoa.
